label: CONTRIBUTING.md#.graph merge strategy
title: CONTRIBUTING.md#.graph merge strategy
summary: .graph/ is intentionally git-versioned, but attempt-branch worktrees (branch_task) can diverge it — merging an attempt back would hit delete/modify and checkpoint.json conflicts. .gitattributes therefore assigns .graph/** merge=ours: the daemon is the source of truth for graph state, so on any merge the current branch's .graph wins wholesale — graph files are never content-merged.
